question: Why does a physical sign have economic value to a business — and what determines how much?
summary: Derived four orthogonal sign functions (awareness, wayfinding, expectation-setting, credibility) and a multiplicative value formula T×CR_c×CR_v×LTV. Corpus confirms capital-asset/zero-marginal-cost insight (rediscovered) but lacks the orthogonal decomposition, multiplicative model, and value-based pricing implication.
